state.product: Miu World: online Minecraft-like 3D voxel learning game for all ages, web on phones/iPads today, mobile app later. North star: lively, never boring.
state.decision_already_made: Boss fights become a duel in the running 3D world: the real boss model faces the child, the camera frames both, the question is a compact card; each turn the child answers through a varied play move (fling a charm at the right shield, tap the right floating orb, drag a gem onto the right answer, tap to charge a combo). Right answer: the child's attack lands, boss staggers, HP drains. Wrong: harmless boss counter, child dodges. No timer. The server still judges every pick, HP and rewards. Support layers (guide, hint after 1 wrong, answer after 2 wrong) and the copy-into-notebook card after each right answer stay.
facts: 59 boss fights with 290 questions: 12 big bosses, 42 zone guardians, 5 Olympic Math event bosses. 58 bosses are Cube Pets models with idle/dance/nod/shake clips; one is a stone knight with its own clips. No new assets needed.

Two co-op flows exist: a boss fight played in a party (shared HP, players take turns) will use the new duel screen. Separately, 3 co-op challenges of kind team-boss (quests with-*) run on their own co-op board UI.
The plan keeps the server API unchanged: the client sends {turnId, choice}.
The current learning rule: wrong tries count toward a small score penalty; support layers open after wrong tries.
6 sound cues already exist in the game.
On page reload mid-fight the child may be far from the boss; the game has standBeside and teleport helpers.
The old BossScreen component would be replaced by the new BossDuel; keeping both means two screens to maintain.
Owner rule: content must be varied and never repetitive; data-driven content is checked by content:check.

coop-team-boss.instructions: The 3 co-op team-boss challenges (quests with-*) run on their own co-op board. What should this delivery do with them?

criteria.keep-as-is: Leave them on their current co-op board this delivery; only boss fights inside quests (solo and party) get the new duel.
criteria.convert-now: Also move the 3 team-boss challenges onto the new duel screen in this delivery, adding scope to the co-op board flow.

move-assignment.instructions: How should the play move for each boss turn be chosen?

criteria.pure-function: A pure tested function duelMoveFor(bossId, run, turnIndex) rotates the four moves so two turns in a row never repeat and a 4-5 turn fight uses all four; no new content fields.
criteria.content-field: Each boss turn declares its move in the content JSON, checked by content:check; authors pick moves by hand for 290 questions.

dim-wrong.instructions: After a wrong pick in a turn, should that wrong answer target be dimmed or removed for the rest of the turn?

criteria.keep-visible: No: the wrong target bounces the throw off and stays, keeping the current learning rule where the child must reason again.
criteria.dim-it: Yes: dim the wrong target so the next try is easier.

criteria.reuse-cues: Reuse the 6 existing sound cues, no new audio assets this delivery.
criteria.new-audio: Add new duel sound effects through the asset pipeline.

reload-mid-fight.instructions: On page reload mid-fight when the child is far from the boss, what happens?

criteria.teleport-beside: Move the child beside the boss with standBeside + teleport and resume the duel; if no place to stand, fall back to a static duel card.
criteria.static-card: Always show the static duel card after a reload, no teleport.

old-screen.instructions: What to do with the old BossScreen component?

criteria.replace: Replace it with the new BossDuel (git mv), one screen to maintain; the static fallback lives inside BossDuel.
criteria.keep-both: Keep the old screen beside the new one behind a switch.
